## Google Review Request (Lite, MIT)
1. Edit CONFIG in **Decide** (business name, review link, Twilio number + SID).
2. Add Twilio Basic Auth credentials on **Send SMS (Twilio)**.
3. Activate. POST `{name, phone}` to `/webhook/review-lite/job-complete`; set your Twilio number's Messaging webhook to `/webhook/review-lite/sms-inbound` (handles STOP).
Want email, ClickSend, a reminder, click tracking, owner alerts and AU compliance docs? See the Pro pack.
